content.name: Oluwaseun Adeyemi
content.title: Lead Security Analyst
content.summary: Lead security analyst with 16 years in insurance, managed security and asset management, now heading detection and response for a retail group with 410 stores. Built a 24/7 hybrid SOC of eight analysts and an MSSP partner that contains most incidents within an hour. CISSP holder with an MSc in Information Security from Royal Holloway.

experience.title: IT Security Administrator
bullets: Managed antivirus, web proxy and firewall changes for 700 staff across two offices.
Ran monthly user-access reviews for the claims system and removed 140 leaver accounts in the first cycle.
Assisted the external auditor during the firm's first ISO/IEC 27001 certification.

experience.title: SOC Analyst
bullets: Monitored and analysed alerts for 25 clients in finance, law and local government on a rotating shift pattern.
Wrote the playbook for ransomware triage that became the SOC standard for all tiers.
Led technical investigation on 12 major incidents, producing client reports that met regulator notification timelines.
Moved from Tier 1 to Tier 3 analyst and ran the internal training programme for new starters.

experience.title: Senior Cyber Security Analyst
bullets: Built the in-house threat detection function, including SIEM onboarding of 180 log sources.
Ran a red-team-informed hardening programme that closed 85% of high-risk findings within one year.
Produced security reporting for the board and evidence for FCA operational resilience requirements.
Managed a £350,000 annual tooling budget for SIEM, EDR and email security.

experience.title: Lead Security Analyst
bullets: Lead a team of eight analysts and an MSSP partner providing 24/7 detection across 410 stores, distribution centres and e-commerce.
Brought median time to contain confirmed incidents from 6 hours to 50 minutes through automated SOAR playbooks.
Directed the response to a credential-stuffing attack on the loyalty app, protecting 1.2 million customer accounts with no confirmed losses.
Maintain PCI DSS v4.0 logging and monitoring controls and present quarterly threat briefings to the executive committee.

education.details: Distinction. Dissertation on detecting lateral movement from Windows event logs.

achievements.title: Speaker, UK security conference
achievements.detail: Presented on building hybrid in-house and MSSP SOCs to an audience of about 250.

achievements.title: Mentor, CyberFirst outreach
achievements.detail: Volunteer mentor for sixth-form students interested in security careers.
